body.name: \overline\Omega_{G,\mathcal J}\text{ and }\pi_{G,\mathcal J}
body.construction: For \(\omega=(r,\kappa)\) and \(\omega'=(r',\kappa')\), define \(\omega\sim_{G,\mathcal J}\omega'\) if and only if \(r=r'\) and \(T_{G,\mathcal J}(\omega)=T_{G,\mathcal J}(\omega')\). Set \(\overline\Omega_{G,\mathcal J}=\Omega_{G,\mathcal J}/\!\sim_{G,\mathcal J}\), \(\pi_{G,\mathcal J}(\omega)=[\omega]_{\sim_{G,\mathcal J}}\), and let \(\overline T_{G,\mathcal J}\) be the unique map with \(\overline T_{G,\mathcal J}\circ\pi_{G,\mathcal J}=T_{G,\mathcal J}\).
